description: This file implements a JiraService class that provides methods for authenticating users, fetching user projects, and getting detailed information about projects from the Jira REST API. It uses the requests library for HTTP communication and defines multiple public methods for interacting with Jira's API endpoints.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: A service class that encapsulates interactions with the Jira REST API, providing methods for authentication, project retrieval, and project details.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the JiraService with a requests session.

methods.name: str _get_auth_header(self, email: str, api_token: str)
methods.description: Creates a base64 encoded Basic Auth header for Jira API authentication.

methods.name: str _get_base_url(self, domain: str)
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for Jira based on the provided domain.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] authenticate_user(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user against Jira by fetching current user profile and returns user info if successful.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] fetch_user_projects(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)
methods.description: Retrieves all accessible projects for the authenticated user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_project_details(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str, project_key: str)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific Jira project identified by its key.
